description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Use Choose Resistances to pick two of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant or Thunder (change them after a Long Rest). Energy Redirection: when you take damage of a chosen type, you're offered your Reaction to target a creature within 60 feet: it makes a Dexterity save (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or takes 2d12 + your Constitution modifier of that type.

activation.condition: When you take the boon or finish a Long Rest
You take damage of one of your chosen types

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Choose Resistances activity sets two Resistances; Energy Redirection Reaction (DEX save or 2d12 + CON of a chosen type).
